basis: Ranges are our judgment inside the sourced market ranges for a first-year solo social media freelancer serving restaurants and cafes (research/niches/social.json). Monthly posts: Boomp $300 to $800 for a person who makes the posts, eClincher $300 to $800 for beginners. With a shoot: Boomp $500 to $1,500. 4 Reels: Apaya $800 to $1,500. Single posts: WebFX $40 to $150 each. A shoot on site: Thumbtack commercial photography $299 to $645 (research/niches/photo.json). Ads management: eClincher $500 to $2,000 a month.

packages.label: Trial week of 3 posts
includes: 3 posts from your menu and your place, shot on a phone in good light
Captions with your prices as printed, and 3 to 5 hashtags
Every post goes to you for a yes first
Scheduled on the days we agree

packages.label: 4 Reels
includes: 4 short vertical videos (15 to 30 seconds) shot at your place
A shot list agreed before the shoot
Music from the Meta Sound Collection, licensed for business accounts

packages.label: Menu photo shoot
includes: Up to 2 hours at your place before service, in window light
20 edited photos of dishes, drinks, the room and the sign
For your posts, website, Google profile and delivery apps

addons.label: Ads management, a month (you pay Meta for the ads)

care_plans.label: Monthly posts

Captions with your prices as printed, and 3 to 5 hashtags

care_plans.summary: 3 posts a week on Instagram and Facebook, each one approved by you first, and a one-page report each month

care_plans.label: Monthly posts with a shoot

care_plans.summary: a shoot at your place each month, 3 posts a week and 2 Reels, each one approved by you first, and a one-page report
